If your evenings feel like a second shift, nothing is wrong with you. Your day never got a full stop. A sticky note, a shut laptop and one change of scene is enough to start. Tell me in the comments: what's the first thing you do when you get home? Reset, not restart. Image created with AI.

#eveningroutine #workingwomen #womenover35 #mentalload #worklifebalance

Today is National Stress Awareness Day. Be honest: which one have you said this week? Tell me the number in the comments, and send this to the friend who always says “I'm fine”. Reset, not restart. Image created with AI.

#stressawarenessday #workingwomen #womenover35 #mentalload #imfine

Today is National Stress Awareness Day. Be honest: which one have you said this week? Tell me the number in the comments, and send this to the friend who always says “I'm fine”. Reset, not restart. Image created with AI.

#stressawarenessday #workingwomen #womenover35 #mentalload #imfine

If you've started again more Mondays than you can count, it's not you and you're not hopeless at routines. The plan was built for a quiet week. Give one habit a two-minute version and keep that going when life turns up. Which habit would you pick? Tell me below. Reset, not restart. Image created with AI.

#tinyhabits #routines #womenover35 #workingwomen #smallsteps

That moment in the car before you go in? So many of us do it. It's the working day still running. One slow breath for each thing you're leaving behind, then go in. Send this to someone who sits in the car too. Reset, not restart. Image created with AI.

#workingwomen #womenover35 #eveningroutine #mentalload #decompress

If you've been putting off an appointment because you're worried you'll be told it's stress, this one is for you. You're not making a fuss. Two weeks of simple notes help your GP help you. Comment RESET and I'll send you my two-page prep sheet. Education only, not medical advice. Please speak to your GP about your symptoms. Reset, not restart. Image created with AI.

#gpappointment #womenshealth #womenover35 #womenover40 #ukwomen

If your brain starts on tomorrow the second you sit down, you're not bad at relaxing. Nothing told your head that work had finished. One sticky note before you log off gives it somewhere to put the list. Save this for tomorrow at five. Reset, not restart. Image created with AI.

#eveningroutine #workingwomen #womenover35 #tinyhabits #worklifebalance

If you've ever walked out of an appointment having said none of what you meant to, you're not alone. Write it down first: what changed, when it started, what it stops you doing. Comment RESET for my two-page prep sheet. Education only, not medical advice. Please speak to your GP about your symptoms. Reset, not restart. Image created with AI.

#gpappointment #womenshealth #womenover35 #womenover40 #ukwomen

The car is the only room where nobody needs anything from you. That's why you sit there. Tonight, before you get out, pick one thing that can wait until tomorrow. What's yours? Tell me below. Reset, not restart.

#workingwomen #womenover35 #mentalload #clockoff #eveningroutine

Rest was never on the list, so it never got done. You're not bad at it. You've never been given permission. This is your permission. Send this to someone who needs it. Small smile: even your phone gets put on charge at night. You don't need to start again. Reset, not restart.

#womenover35 #workingwomen #restisproductive #mentalload #clockoff

The laptop shuts at six. The list keeps running until midnight. Tonight, write tomorrow's first task on a sticky note and stick it on the lid. Be honest: what time did your head actually stop yesterday? Reset, not restart.

#workingwomen #worklifebalance #womenover35 #clockoff #tinyhabits

For the days when ten minutes to wind down feels like a joke. Ninety seconds, three steps, and your evening has a starting line. Save this for tomorrow at five. Reset, not restart.

#eveningroutine #workingwomen #womenover35 #clockoff #tinyhabits

"I'm fine" is quicker than explaining. And explaining feels like one more job. Tonight, try one true sentence with one person. Send this to the friend who always says she's fine. Reset, not restart.

#imfine #womenover35 #mentalload #workingwomen #clockoff

You're probably the most organised person you know. That's exactly why you're tired. Remembering everything for everyone is work, it never gets counted. What's one thing only you ever remember? Tell me below. Reset, not restart.

#mentalload #invisiblelabour #womenover35 #workingwomen #clockoff

When it's dark at 4.30, nothing tells you the day has ended. So make your own sunset: big light off, lamp on, and let that be your clock-off. Try it tonight and tell me if it changes anything. Reset, not restart. Image created with AI.

#darkevenings #workingwomen #womenover35 #clockoff #eveningroutine

Ten minutes goes fast when you've never had the chance to rehearse. Three lines on paper make the difference. Comment RESET and I'll send you my two-page GP prep sheet. You can also get it through the link in my bio. Education only, not medical advice. Please speak to your GP about your symptoms. Reset, not restart.

#gpappointment #womenshealth #womenover35 #womenover40 #ukwomen

You'd never let your best friend work until 10pm every night. You'd say something. Tonight, say it to yourself. Out loud, if you can. Send this to the friend who needs to hear it, then read it again yourself. Reset, not restart.

#workingwomen #womenover35 #worklifebalance #clockoff #bekindtoyourself

Everyone leans on you. Who do you lean on? If the answer is nobody, that's not a strength you have to keep proving. Tell one person this week what would help. Small smile: the kettle has looked after you more than most people this week. Thank the kettle. You don't need to start again. Reset, not restart.

#womenover35 #sandwichgeneration #mentalload #workingwomen #clockoff

It's World Kindness Day. Start with the person you're hardest on. Pick one line and say the friend version to yourself tonight. Which one do you say most? Reset, not restart.

#worldkindnessday #bekindtoyourself #womenover35 #workingwomen #clockoff

It was never you. It was a plan built for a quiet week. Give one habit a two-minute version and it survives the hard weeks too. Which habit would you pick? Reset, not restart.

#tinyhabits #routines #womenover35 #workingwomen #smallsteps

Nobody ever told her she was allowed to stop. So here it is: you're allowed to stop. Tonight, put the laptop in another room. Send this to someone who opens it again at nine. Reset, not restart. Image created with AI.

#workingwomen #worklifebalance #womenover35 #clockoff #eveningroutine

Feeling flat at 8pm isn't ingratitude. It's a full day landing all at once. Decide dinner at lunchtime and give future you a break. Send this to someone who needs it tonight. Reset, not restart.

#eveningroutine #workingwomen #womenover35 #mentalload #clockoff

If you've ever added things you've already done to your list so you can tick them off, this one's for you. Nobody else noticed what you did today, so notice it yourself. Tonight, write a done list. Three things. What's on yours? Reset, not restart.

#donelist #womenover35 #workingwomen #mentalload #clockoff

For many of us it starts with small things we put down to stress. If your normal has changed, it's worth a conversation, and you don't need to be sure first. What made you first wonder? Your answer might help someone reading. Education only, not medical advice. Please speak to your GP about your symptoms. Reset, not restart.

#perimenopause #womenover40 #womenshealth #ukwomen #gpappointment

The Christmas list in your head is a second job with no clock-off. Two minutes tonight: get it all on one page, then put someone else's name next to three things. Who's getting the advent calendars this year? Reset, not restart.

#mentalload #christmasprep #womenover35 #workingwomen #clockoff

There will always be one more thing. So rest can't wait until it's all done. Stop anyway, tonight. Save this for the evening you think you haven't earned it. Small smile: the washing basket will never be empty either, and it has never once said thank you. You don't need to start again. Reset, not restart.

#womenover35 #workingwomen #restisproductive #mentalload #clockoff

You waited three weeks, then heard yourself say "I'm fine, a bit tired". It happens to so many of us. Three lines on paper change the whole appointment. Comment RESET and I'll send you my two-page GP prep sheet. Education only, not medical advice. Please speak to your GP about your symptoms. Reset, not restart. Image created with AI.

#gpappointment #womenshealth #womenover35 #womenover40 #ukwomen

"I'm fine" is the most-used sentence in the country after 6pm. Swap one for something true tonight. Which one do you say most? Tell me the number. Reset, not restart.

#imfine #womenover35 #mentalload #workingwomen #clockoff

None of these are character flaws. They're what carrying everything sounds like. Pick one and do the opposite once tonight. Which one is yours? Reset, not restart.

#workingwomen #womenover35 #mentalload #clockoff #worklifebalance

Hard weeks are when habits matter most and feel hardest. Every one of ours has a tiny version. Save this. You'll want it on a Wednesday. Reset, not restart.

#tinyhabits #routines #womenover35 #workingwomen #smallsteps

For most of us there's no gap: work ends and the next shift starts in the hallway. Try a doorway minute tonight. What's the first thing you do when you walk in? One word. Reset, not restart.

#workingwomen #womenover35 #eveningroutine #clockoff #mentalload

Knowing the words makes the conversation easier. Perimenopause is the time before menopause, it can start in your 40s or earlier, and you can bring notes rather than certainty. Save this for your next appointment. Education only, not medical advice. Please speak to your GP about your symptoms. Reset, not restart.

#perimenopause #womenover40 #womenshealth #ukwomen #gpappointment

Friday at five, and instead of relief you feel flat. That's what running on empty all week feels like. Put one hour this weekend in the calendar for nobody but you, and guard it. What will you do with it? Reset, not restart.

#weekendvibes #workingwomen #womenover35 #clockoff #mentalload

Behind on what, exactly? Look at what you're carrying. Send this to someone who needs to hear it tonight. Small smile: nobody has ever finished their to-do list. Not even the people on Instagram. You don't need to start again. Reset, not restart.

#womenover35 #workingwomen #mentalload #sandwichgeneration #clockoff

Save this for tomorrow night. Ten minutes on Sunday, and Monday stops living in your head. Bad week? Do number 1 only. That still counts. Reset, not restart.

#sundayreset #workingwomen #womenover35 #clockoff #tinyhabits

Two weeks of learning to clock off. Which one helped most? Tell me the number below. I read every comment. Reset, not restart.

#clockoff #workingwomen #womenover35 #tinyhabits #mentalload
